name: glitchless
description: Coding agents can build a game. They can't see anyone play it. Glitchless lets them. Glitchless for Claude Code: add game observability to a Three.js, Phaser, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, Unity, Godot, Unreal or GameMaker game, then find and fix what real players hit (stutters, crashes, where they quit) from their sessions (Glitchless MCP) and the running game (WebMCP).
